merge_commit_message:
squash: heterogeneous flashfusion attn + rotary compressor + kv slab allocator

Implements heterogeneous kernel selection and runtime+allocator improvements to reduce latency and improve throughput for mixed-length workloads. See ENG-1981.
release_notes: Introduce heterogenous FlashFusion dispatcher with fused rotary reduction, rotary offset compression reducing KV metadata, and a KV slab allocator for faster allocations and lower fragmentation. Feature gate: runtime.hetero_flashfusion.enabled. Performance: up to ~24% throughput improvement on mixed-length workloads; p50 latency improved ~18% in benchmarks.
observability_changes: Added counters: runtime.kv.slab_fragmentation, runtime.kv.alloc_latency_ms, runtime.kv.high_water_bytes, runtime.attn.preferred_kernel_dispatch_count. Dashboards: perf-dashboard experiment/88921-canary
notes_for_release_engineering: Canary rollout via runtime flag; monitor runtime.kv.high_water_bytes and OOM events. If OOMs observed, flip runtime.kv.force_legacy_allocator to true for the affected instance pool.
